subject: Integrated lighting and accessory storage
hook: Can I add lighting to my wardrobe later?
fb:
"Can I add lighting to my wardrobe later?"

Usually, yes, but it won't be as tidy. Retrofitted lights tend to be surface-mounted or battery-powered, with cables that have to go somewhere visible. Planned in at design stage, the cable routes are drilled inside the units before assembly and it all looks built in.

Not sure you want lights yet? We can plan the routes now so it's easy to add them later. Ask us below or book a free design consultation.

gbp:
"Can I add lighting to my fitted wardrobe later?"

Usually, yes, but the result is rarely as neat. Lighting added after a wardrobe is built tends to be surface-mounted or battery-powered, and any mains cable has to run somewhere visible.

When lighting is planned at design stage, the supply point and cable routes are marked on the drawings, holes and channels are machined in our Hanley workshop before assembly, and a qualified electrician makes the connection once the wardrobe is fitted. The wiring stays hidden inside the units.

If you're not sure you want lights yet, we can plan the routes into your wardrobe now so they're simple to add later.

Every fitted wardrobe starts with a free, no-obligation design consultation, followed by an itemised quote, manufacture in our own workshop and installation by our team. Book a consultation to talk it through.
